title: Alvin Boyarsky
body: From 1971 until his death in 1990, Alvin Boyarsky held autocratic sway over the Architectural Association at Bedford Square, transforming the AA into a major international cultural institution. With the removal from the AA of UK student grants, Boyarsky seized the opportunity, and indeed the necessity, to make the school a global concern, embarking upon a highly ambitious programme of exhibitions, catalogues and publications.
